description: Gene therapy is a form of treatment that involves the insertion of healthy copies of genes into cells in order to replace or supplement mutated or missing proteins. The mutated genes can be replaced with healthy versions or missing genes can be added. The healthy genes are delivered to the cells via a carrier molecule called a vector.
